workflow: A clearing operation retrieves each record key into newly allocated temporary storage.
The operation removes the record but does not release the temporary key storage on either successful or error termination.
Repeated clearing operations leave each retrieved key allocation unreclaimed.
Leak detection reports persistent memory growth instead of clean reclamation.
summary: Successful operation omits cleanup of temporary allocated key state
decision_reason: The bug is materially the same as the existing cluster: a data-processing operation obtains temporary owned heap state and omits releasing it after processing, causing repeated operations to leak memory.
